maintenance_implication: Keep AgentSpec's seven necessary constructs (Workflow.params, on_failure/Loop.convergence_expr, Subworkflow, named artifacts/partial-artifact, RepairLoop, timeout as a closed family, HumanCheckpoint). Do not add GitHub Actions strategy.matrix cartesian axes; DynamicFanOut already covers receipt-driven fan-out. Treat Temporal/Prefect/Dagster host-language `if` as an escape, not as a declarative conditional. GitHub Actions cannot express RepairLoop without a third-party retry action.

necessity.cannot_express_without: A blueprint library is instantiable only if typed params exist on Workflow (spec.py:Workflow.params); otherwise each of the 96 categories collapses to a hardcoded script.
Reliability blueprints must dispatch on closed failure families (timeout, schema-invalid, truncated-output, ...) without an embedded Python predicate. That is declarative branching.
necessity.spec_anchor: on_failure family map + Loop.convergence_expr in spec.py

necessity.cannot_express_without: Meta/council blueprints compose other workflows by reference. Without a sub-workflow construct the 96-item library cannot nest and would escape to subprocess or copy-paste.

necessity.spec_anchor: IMP-0132 DynamicFanOut (receipt-driven cardinality, not cartesian axes)
necessity.why_not_necessary: GitHub Actions strategy.matrix is a static cartesian product (os × version). None of the six blueprint families requires that CI packaging shape. AgentSpec already has DynamicFanOut, whose width comes from a producer receipt (max_cardinality), which is a different construct. Marking matrix_expansion NECESSARY would turn this matrix into a wish list.

necessity.cannot_express_without: Evidence blueprints must produce claim records as named artifacts. The closed failure family partial-artifact is unrepresentable if the DSL cannot name an artifact.
Reliability blueprints retry bounded repair without dropping into a general-purpose loop in host code.
timeout is a closed failure-taxonomy family. A DSL that cannot name a deadline cannot classify that family without host-language timers.
Governance blueprints stop for an owner decision and resume from a pause_token. Without a checkpoint node they hang or skip the human gate in code.

negative_control.why: GitHub Actions strategy.matrix is a static cartesian product (os × version). None of the six blueprint families requires that CI packaging shape. AgentSpec already has DynamicFanOut, whose width comes from a producer receipt (max_cardinality), which is a different construct. Marking matrix_expansion NECESSARY would turn this matrix into a wish list.
